title: Guardrails around your model
label: Your model sits inside four guardrail rings: an input filter, PII redaction, a policy check and an output check. Two prompts, from a support bot and a search widget, pass every ring. A third, from an anonymous session, is stopped at the input filter, which closes with the chip Blocked, prompt injection. The log beside the rings counts 2 allowed and 1 blocked.
heading:
Every prompt passes
four checks first.
sub: Filter, redact, check policy, then check the answer. The model only sees what made it through.
